doc.title: Albert Warner and Sonny Henry Interview, 1959-01-08

chapter: Eureka Brass Band and Sonny Henry
title: Warner and Sonny Henry's trombone signals and a humbug
summary: Warner explains their horn signals; they recall a recent mix-up on a trip back in the car.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: You see, like him and I, we're about the only two that I know of. Wait together. You see, now, like sometimes you might see me look over at him. Well, that means that I'm going down, you see. If I throw my horn up, he know I'm going to pick up. And if I lay my horn down like this, he know that I'm going to pull down. If he do the same thing, I know he's going to take down, you see. And if he put his horn up, I know he's going to go up. So that's why you see him and I, sometimes you see one of us down, one up. We understand. We understand this way. And we never let one another get out of step.
I'll give him that all the time. All the only this last time. All the last time he messed me up. One time I thought that.

You know, this last time he messed me up. He kept saying to me, he said, Ow, ow, ow. Him, hmm. I said, God darn it. Every time I come, I come on. I said, no, I see them tricks. I said, son, I said, eat you, eat you. He said, you know something? He said, I done made the humbug. I said, I know you made the humbug.

He said, I know you made the humbug. Yeah, that's right. You see, when I'm wrong, I'll give up. You understand? Because that's one thing to me. I don't care how good you can be wrong one time. Oh, sure. I don't care how good you can be wrong. I said, well, I said, it's me. I said, it's all me this time. And then the first time, since we've been playing, that I haven't gone, I don't lie.

Well, that was when we ended up around Claiborne and, what was it, Louisiana? Is that the one you're talking about? Yeah. Where we rode back in the car together? Where you had the humbug? Yeah, we all came back in the car together.
Yeah, the thing. The left fuel? Yeah, yeah. That's the one you had. Yeah, yeah. The left fuel, yeah. The left fuel, yeah. That's what you had.
